name: Sculpfun S70 MAX 70W
tagline: 2025 flagship Sculpfun diode : 70W class on the S40/S70 large frame
tldr: Sculpfun's S70 MAX pushes the S-series frame to ~70W optical class for shops that want maximum diode cutting depth without CO₂. Same oversized bed philosophy as S40 MAX : premium pricing and workshop space requirements apply.
mainObjective: Top-tier Sculpfun large-format cutting with maximum diode power

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Large bed for signs and furniture panels
Competes with Atomstack A70 on paper specs
cons: Premium over S40 MAX for moderate users
beginnerNotes: Compare Atomstack A70 Max and Acmer P3 before buying : similar power class, different software and community.
proTips: If you don't need 70W daily, S40 MAX at 48W often offers better value per watt.
primaryUse: 2025 maximum-power Sculpfun for large-format cutting and high-throughput engraving.
